plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Gigamon network service device. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, and interface traffic, for GigaVUE HC / TA / G-series (enterprise PEN 26866).
name: NetworkService

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart (sysUpTime). By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the Gigamon appliance and identify potential reboot or failure issues.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: Overall CPU utilization of the Gigamon GigaVUE chassis (GIGAMON-SNMP-MIB, reported directly as a percentage). Sustained high CPU means the visibility node is near its processing capacity for traffic forwarding and filtering.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: System memory utilization of the Gigamon GigaVUE chassis (GIGAMON-SNMP-MIB, reported directly as a percentage). Sustained high memory may indicate map/flow-table pressure on the packet broker.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: device_total_incoming_traffic
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of total bytes received by the entire device over the past 5 minutes, summed from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counters.

metrics.name: device_total_outgoing_traffic
metrics.description: This metric represents the average rate of total bytes sent by the entire device over the past 5 minutes, summed from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counters.
